title: Sign-flip invariance of linear threshold functions
statement: For every dimension $n$, every sign vector $z\in\{\pm1\}^n$, and every linear threshold function $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, the function $x\mapsto f(z_1x_1,\ldots,z_nx_n)$ is also a linear threshold function.
hypotheses_covered: $z$ is a sign vector of length $n$
$f$ belongs to the linear threshold class in dimension $n$
